triviaQuestion: Which superconducting metal powers quantum computer circuits?

hints.title: OLD MACHINES
hints.text: The old mine's machines still run - carts, lifts, powder barrels. Master them, then pass the test at the end.

hints.title: MINECART
hints.text: Walk into a minecart to shove it rolling - it flattens everything down the line. See that snake ahead? Send it a delivery.

hints.title: RUNAWAY CART
hints.text: Below, a runaway cart rolls from wall to wall without end, and touching it is fatal. Wait in this shaft, watch its rhythm and dart across the moment it has passed.

hints.title: SHAFT LIFT
hints.text: An old lift still patrols the vertical lane to the west, crushing anything in its path. Wait in the alcove beside the lane, let it pass, then cross. You'll cross its lane twice!

hints.title: POWDER BARREL
hints.text: These barrels roll when shoved and explode on impact. Shove this one at the ice wall ahead: the blast cracks the vault open.

hints.title: SPIDER NEST
hints.text: Behind the earth above you sits a spider nest, hatching one spider after another. Leave that earth alone and they stay walled in. In the open mines, dynamite a nest before it overruns you.

hints.title: THE LOGIC DOOR
hints.text: Answer pads! Read the question on the wall and step on the pad with the correct element to open the logic doors. A wrong pad costs 30 seconds on the clock.

hints.title: MACHINES MASTERED
hints.text: Carts, lifts, barrels and logic doors - you've mastered the machines. Collect the niobium and take the exit. One lesson left: the survival kit for the deepest mines.
